title: "DESeq2 Analysis Report"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
params:
  context_path: NULL

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(plotly)
  library(DT)
  library(htmltools)
  library(knitr)
  library(tibble)
})

context <- readRDS(params$context_path)

sig_mask <- function(df, alpha, lfc_threshold) {
  !is.na(df$padj) &
    df$padj < alpha &
    !is.na(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk) &
    abs(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= lfc_threshold
}

ordered_hits <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_lfc = abs(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk),
      padj_sort = ifelse(is.na(.data$padj), Inf, .data$padj)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$padj_sort, dplyr::desc(.data$abs_lfc))
}

make_volcano <- function(results_df, feature_labels, comparison, group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold, label_top_n) {
  df <- results_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      significant = sig_mask(results_df, alpha, lfc_threshold),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0 ~ paste("Up in", group1),
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0 ~ paste("Up in", group2),
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(.data$padj) & .data$padj > 0,
        -log10(.data$padj),
        NA_real_
      ),
      feature_label = feature_labels
    )

  top_labels <- ordered_hits(df %>% dplyr::filter(.data$significant)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = label_top_n)

  plot_obj <- ggplot(df, aes(
    x = .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk,
    y = .data$neg_log10_padj,
    color = .data$direction,
    text = paste0(
      feature_labels,
      "<br>padj: ", signif(.data$padj, 3),
      "<br>log2FC: ", signif(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk, 3)
    )
  )) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        paste("Up in", group1) = "#c0392b",
        paste("Up in", group2) = "#1f618d",
        "Not significant" = "#9e9e9e"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Shrunken log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      color = "Call"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  if (nrow(top_labels) > 0) {
    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = top_labels,
        aes(label = .data$feature_label),
        size = 3,
        show.legend = FALSE,
        max.overlaps = Inf
      )
  }

  plotly::ggplotly(plot_obj, tooltip = "text")
}

make_ma <- function(results_df, comparison, group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold) {
  df <- results_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      significant = sig_mask(results_df, alpha, lfc_threshold),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0 ~ paste("Up in", group1),
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0 ~ paste("Up in", group2),
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data$baseMean, y = .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk, color = .data$direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        paste("Up in", group1) = "#c0392b",
        paste("Up in", group2) = "#1f618d",
        "Not significant" = "#9e9e9e"
      )
    ) +
    labs(x = "baseMean", y = "Shrunken log2 fold change", color = "Call") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

summary_table <- function(results_df, group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold) {
  sig_mask_vals <- sig_mask(results_df, alpha, lfc_threshold)
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = c(
      "Features tested",
      "Significant",
      paste("Up in", group1),
      paste("Up in", group2)
    ),
    value = c(
      nrow(results_df),
      sum(sig_mask_vals),
      sum(sig_mask_vals & results_df$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(sig_mask_vals & results_df$log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

top_hits_table <- function(results_df, top_n) {
  ordered_hits(results_df) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)
}

full_results_table <- function(results_df, max_rows) {
  if (nrow(results_df) <= max_rows) return(results_df)
  results_df %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = max_rows)
}

download_link <- function(tsv_path) {
  htmltools::tags$p(
    htmltools::tags$a(
      href = basename(tsv_path),
      target = "_blank",
      "Download TSV"
    )
  )
}

render_skipped_section <- function(matrix_label, skip_info, tsv_path) {
  cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", matrix_label))

  skip_icon <- "⏭️"
  if (skip_info$skip_type == "skip_list") {
    skip_msg <- "User-configured skip (in skip_features list)"
  } else if (skip_info$skip_type == "insufficient_features") {
    skip_msg <- "Skipped due to insufficient features after filtering"
    skip_icon <- "⚠️"
  } else {
    skip_msg <- "Skipped (reason unknown)"
  }

  cat(sprintf("> **%s ANALYSIS SKIPPED** — %s\n>\n> %s\n\n",
              skip_icon, matrix_label, skip_msg))

  if (!is.na(skip_info$reason)) {
    cat(sprintf("> **Reason:** %s\n\n", skip_info$reason))
  }

  print(download_link(tsv_path))
  cat("\n")
}

render_matrix_section <- function(matrix_section, matrix_label, group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold, report_top_n, report_label_top_n, report_max_table_rows) {
  results_df <- matrix_section$results
  feature_labels <- safe_feature_labels(results_df)

  cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", matrix_label))
  print(download_link(matrix_section$tsv_path))

  cat("#### Summary\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(summary_table(results_df, group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold)))

  cat("\n#### Volcano Plot\n\n")
  print(make_volcano(results_df, feature_labels, "Comparison", group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold, report_label_top_n))

  cat("\n#### MA Plot\n\n")
  print(make_ma(results_df, "Comparison", group1, group2, alpha, lfc_threshold))

  cat("\n#### Top Hits\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(top_hits_table(results_df, report_top_n)))

  cat("\n#### Full Results\n\n")
  print(
    DT::datatable(
      full_results_table(results_df, report_max_table_rows),
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 25,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv")
      ),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
  )

  if (nrow(results_df) > report_max_table_rows) {
    cat(sprintf("\nFull results table truncated to first %d rows.\n\n", report_max_table_rows))
  }
}

safe_feature_labels <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("gene_name", "gene_id", "bin_id", "chrom")
  preferred_column <- NA_character_
  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (candidate %in% colnames(df)) {
      values <- as.character(df[[candidate]])
      if (any(nzchar(values))) {
        preferred_column <- candidate
        break
      }
    }
  }

  if (!is.na(preferred_column) && preferred_column %in% colnames(df)) {
    labels <- as.character(df[[preferred_column]])
    labels[!nzchar(labels)] <- NA_character_
  } else {
    labels <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
  }

  if ("bin_id" %in% colnames(df)) {
    labels[is.na(labels)] <- as.character(df$bin_id[is.na(labels)])
  }

  has_coords <- all(c("chrom", "start", "end") %in% colnames(df))
  if (has_coords) {
    coord_labels <- paste0(df$chrom, ":", df$start, "-", df$end)
    labels[is.na(labels)] <- coord_labels[is.na(labels)]
  }

  labels[is.na(labels)] <- paste0("feature_", seq_len(sum(is.na(labels))))
  labels
}
```

# DESeq2 Analysis Results {.tabset}

```{r render-contrasts, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (comparison in names(context$result_sections)) {
  section <- context$result_sections[[comparison]]
  group1 <- section$group1
  group2 <- section$group2

  cat(sprintf("## %s {.tabset}\n\n", comparison))

  for (matrix_label in names(section$matrices)) {
    matrix_section <- section$matrices[[matrix_label]]

    if (isTRUE(matrix_section$skipped)) {
      render_skipped_section(
        matrix_label = matrix_label,
        skip_info = matrix_section$skip_info,
        tsv_path = matrix_section$tsv_path
      )
    } else {
      render_matrix_section(
        matrix_section = matrix_section,
        matrix_label = matrix_label,
        group1 = group1, group2 = group2,
        alpha = context$config$alpha,
        lfc_threshold = context$config$lfc_threshold,
        report_top_n = context$config$report_top_n,
        report_label_top_n = context$config$report_label_top_n,
        report_max_table_rows = context$config$report_max_table_rows
      )
    }
  }
}
```
